---
title: "Établi Nuage"
sidebar: en
---

Check URLs from a local CSV or a CSV retrieved by Nextcloud WebDAV path. Keep and share per-run CSV results, optionally uploading them to Nextcloud. A general file browser, Contacts and Calendar are not implemented. Runs require the run screen to stay active.

This page describes the October 2026 source revision. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

[Current implementation, prerequisites and commands](../current-status.qmd)
